Both DOIs resolve (HTTP 302 redirects to the publisher). Let me analyze the Crossref metadata.

**Reference [1] - Obokata et al. 2014:**
- DOI 10.1038/nature12968 resolves (302)
- Crossref title: **"RETRACTED ARTICLE: Stimulus-triggered fate conversion of somatic cells into pluripotency"**
- Volume 505, Issue 7485, pages 641-647, published 2014 — all match
- **BUT**: This is the STAP cell paper, which was **RETRACTED**. The citation omits the retraction status. The title in Crossref includes "RETRACTED ARTICLE:" prefix.

**Reference [2] - LeCun et al. 2015:**
- DOI 10.1038/nature14539 resolves (302)
- Crossref title: "Deep learning"
- Volume 521, Issue 7553, pages 436-444, published 2015
- Authors: Yann LeCun, Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton — all match
- Not retracted. All metadata matches.

Both DOIs are valid. Reference [1] has the retraction issue — the citation omits that the paper was retracted. Reference [2] is fully correct.

```json
{"references":[{"item_id":1,"doi":"10.1038/nature12968","doi_status":"valid","metadata_match":true,"verdict":"confirm","evidence_url":"https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1038/nature12968","issue":"DOI 有效且卷期页(505(7485):641-647)与题录一致,但该文为 STAP 细胞论文,已被撤稿。Crossref 标题为 'RETRACTED ARTICLE: Stimulus-triggered fate conversion of somatic cells into pluripotency',引用中未披露撤稿状态。"},{"item_id":2,"doi":"10.1038/nature14539","doi_status":"valid","metadata_match":true,"verdict":"pass","evidence_url":"https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1038/nature14539","issue":"DOI 有效,作者(LeCun/Bengio/Hinton)、年份(2015)、标题(Deep learning)、卷期页(521(7553):436-444)均与 Crossref 一致,未被撤稿。"}]}
```

**核查结果汇总:**

**[1] Obokata et al. 2014, Nature 505(7485):641-647, doi:10.1038/nature12968 — CONFIRM(有问题)**
- DOI 真实存在(解析返回 302 跳转至 Springer Nature)。
- 卷期页、作者、年份均与 Crossref 一致。
- **关键问题**:这是著名的 STAP 细胞论文,已被撤稿。Crossref 中标题为 "RETRACTED ARTICLE: Stimulus-triggered fate conversion of somatic cells into pluripotency",而引用中未披露撤稿状态。引用被撤稿论文而不加说明属于严重问题。

**[2] LeCun et al. 2015, Nature 521(7553):436-444, doi:10.1038/nature14539 — PASS(无误)**
- DOI 真实存在(解析返回 302 跳转至 Springer Nature)。
- 作者、年份、标题、卷期页均与 Crossref 完全一致。
- 未被撤稿,无任何问题。
